resources.string: Drawing quests, level by level. Tap Start; draw over the dashed lines on the paper or paint the picture in the example colors, then tap Done. If your score is high enough, the next level opens. Progress shows all the levels.
Drawing quests, level by level! Draw the target picture, collect points and win stars.
Level %1$d: %2$s! Draw over the dashed lines with the brush. When you finish, tap Done at the top.
Level %1$d: %2$s! Use the paint bucket to paint the picture in the colors of the dots. When you finish, tap Done.
Level %1$d: %2$s! Find the picture under Add shape, put it on the dashed line and paint it in the colors of the dots.
Pick the brush at the top and slowly trace the dashed line with your finger.
Went over the line? Pick the eraser and rub out the extra bit.
Oops? The back arrow at the top undoes your last step.
Pick the paint bucket, choose the color of the dot and tap that spot.
Hold the bucket on a shape for 2 seconds and the whole shape gets painted at once.
Tap Add shape, pick the %1$s picture and tap the paper to put it down.
Drag the picture with your finger onto the dashed line.
When you are ready, tap the green Done button at the top and I\'ll tell you your score!
Great, you are really close! Tap Done when you are ready.
Great job! The next level is waiting for you.
Amazing! You got all three stars!
You need %1$d points to pass this level. Try again, it will be even better this time!
You passed the last level too! You are a real artist!
This level is locked. Pass level %1$d first!
